announcement.note: (Monday; WotC said so in the Oct 12, 2026 announcement)

estimates.why: P(act) ~53%: WotC's Oct 12 'very likely ... very hard look at the Eldrazi package' (~60%), +10 for the Eldrazi family at ~18% on MTGGoldfish (Eldrazi Ramp still #1 but down to 11.5%), Broodscale Bloodchief #1 on MTGTop8 (10% of 598 decks, down from 12%) and S-tier on Spellslinger (79 top 8s in 30 days, best conversion; Spellslinger effective archetypes falling from ~30 to ~27, so the meta is compressing again); -17 because it did not win the latest big events (Nov 25 Challenge won by Living End and Nov 26 RC Qualifier won by Dimir Control, Broodscale only 5-8th in both), no Modern RC until April 2027 and no new WotC wording as of Nov 28. Goldfish shows a slight decline while Spellslinger shows compression rising, so this is not averaged. x P(Command picked) ~30%: Basking Broodscale, Blade of the Bloodchief or Emrakul are the narrower enablers and Reddit mostly expects a Broodscale ban; the Command is a flexible 4-of in 18% of all Modern decks (#19 staple, also in Tron decks), which WotC avoids hitting.
#38 Legacy staple in 12% of decks; WotC called Legacy Eldrazi proactive and fair. No ban pressure.
Not a Vintage restriction candidate; in Commander it is in 0.78% of EDHREC decks and not on the Game Changers list (Scryfall: 53 Game Changers, Command not among them).

summary: WotC's Oct 12 update warned it is 'very likely that we take a very hard look at the Eldrazi package' if Eldrazi keeps sitting on top, and named Kozilek's Command as a bridge to Emrakul in Broodscale Combo. As of Nov 28, two days before the Nov 30 announcement, there is no new WotC word; the deck is still #1 (MTGGoldfish Eldrazi Ramp 11.5%, MTGTop8 Broodscale Bloodchief 10%) but slipped slightly and only made 5-8th at the latest Challenge and RC Qualifier. If WotC acts, Basking Broodscale, Blade of the Bloodchief or Emrakul is the likelier pick; the Command is a real but secondary target.

sources.title: Modern Metagame (last 2 weeks)
sources.takeaway: 598 decks: Rakdos Aggro 11%, Broodscale Bloodchief 10% (down from 12%), Boros Aggro 8%, Affinity 8%, UW Control 7%.

sources.title: Modern Metagame (full)
sources.takeaway: Eldrazi Ramp #1 at 11.5% (down from 11.9%); Eldrazi-family ~18% combined (Eldrazi Tron 3.6%, Eldrazi 1.7%, Broodscale Combo 0.8%); Boros Energy 7.7%, Amulet Titan 7.5%.

sources.title: Modern Format Staples (all)
sources.takeaway: Kozilek's Command #19 staple, 18% of decks (4.0 copies); Sowing Mycospawn #33 (14%), Emrakul #40 (13%).

sources.title: r/ModernMagic ban discussion thread (comment)
sources.takeaway: 'I suspect broodscale will be banned' (+7): the community expects the Broodscale piece, not the Command, to be hit.

sources.title: Modern RC Qualifier (Nov 26)
sources.takeaway: 140 players, won by Dimir Control; one Broodscale Bloodchief in the top 8 (5-8th).

sources.title: Modern Challenge 32 (Nov 25)
sources.takeaway: 76 players, won by Living End; Broodscale Bloodchief 5-8th, also 10th and 14th.

sources.title: Modern Challenge 32 (Nov 23)
sources.takeaway: 53 players, won by Broodscale Bloodchief (Emrakul, Eldrazi Temple list); a second Broodscale Bloodchief finished 3-4th.

sources.title: Legacy Format Staples
sources.takeaway: #38 Legacy staple, 12% of decks: no Legacy ban pressure.

sources.title: r/ModernMagic: "Urza's Saga as a ban candidate" (top comment)
sources.takeaway: Most upvoted take (+22): 'just ban broodscale or blade and be done with it' rather than weakening many decks.

sources.title: Banned and Restricted Announcement - October 12, 2026
sources.takeaway: No Modern changes; 'very likely that we take a very hard look at the Eldrazi package'; Command named as a bridge to Emrakul; next B&R Nov 30.
